title: EUMH-ATM: PR-3 Thesis Code and Preserved Experiment Outputs
description: PR-3 S0–S13 Python/R implementation and preserved experiment outputs for explainable and uncertainty-aware ATM cash management. The original ZIP is stored in eight binary parts; run packages/reassemble_package.py to reconstruct and verify it. Includes protocol, environment specifications, manifests, prediction ledgers, tables, figures and tests. Full training and clean-environment reproduction were not rerun during deposit. Raw datasets and trained weights are not included. Historical and superseded implementations are separated inside the package. See README_AR.md and REPRODUCIBILITY_STATUS.md for verification limits. No new software licence is granted by this deposit.
